cases.name: base_b1_l1_d8
cases.note: smallest shape; L=1 is also the decode step shape

cases.name: base_b2_l4_d8
cases.note: L equals d_conv; conv window exactly fills; h_all written

cases.name: adv_softplus_guard_b2_l8_d8
cases.note: (a) dt_proj outputs straddle torch's softplus threshold 20 (the CUDA kernel's delta <= 20 guard); bias in [19.875, 20.125], the projected part adds at most a few tenths

cases.name: adv_a_very_negative_b1_l16_d16
cases.note: (b) A in [-22026, -403]; exp(delta*A) crosses the FP32 denormal band [-103.97, -87.34] and underflows to zero; ref64 keeps the true tiny values

cases.name: adv_a_near_zero_b3_l8_d8
cases.note: (c) A in [-6.1e-6, -1.5e-8]; exp(delta*A) is within a few ulp of 1 in FP32 and rounds to exactly 1 for the smallest products

cases.name: adv_signed_zeros_b2_l8_d8
cases.note: (d) x carries whole +0.0 tokens, whole -0.0 tokens and scattered -0.0; RMSNorm of a zero token is 0*rsqrt(eps); a -0.0 token propagates -0.0 through in_proj only if the accumulator starts from the first product, not from +0.0 (the signed-zero hazard)

cases.name: adv_gate_saturation_b1_l8_d16
cases.note: (e) the gate half of in_proj.weight (rows d_inner..2*d_inner) is in [-2^30, 2^30]; z is ~1e9, exp(-z) overflows to inf for negative z so sigmoid saturates to 0 (silu -> -0.0) and to 1 for positive z; the residual is lost in block.out

cases.name: comp_b2_l257_d8
cases.note: (f) long L=257 (one past a 256 chunk) with B=2; its two rows are comp_row0/comp_row1 with the SAME parameters; reduced stage set for size

cases.name: comp_row0_b1_l257_d8
cases.note: (f) row 0 of comp_b2_l257_d8 as a B=1 case (same seed, same parameters, x = parent x[0])

cases.name: comp_row1_b1_l257_d8
cases.note: (f) row 1 of comp_b2_l257_d8 as a B=1 case (same seed, same parameters, x = parent x[1])

seed_rule: seed_k = seed_base + 0x1000 * k, k = case index below; x_source cases reuse the parent's seed

stage_definitions.conv.out: causal depthwise conv1d of the hidden half, kernel 4, padding 3, truncated to L, plus conv1d.bias  [B, d_inner, L]
stage_definitions.dt_proj.out: dt_proj.weight @ dt_low^T + dt_proj.bias  [B, d_inner, L]  (bias INCLUDED)
stage_definitions.in_proj.out: (norm.out @ in_proj.weight^T).transpose(1,2)  [B, 2*d_inner, L]; rows 0..d_inner are the hidden half, rows d_inner..2*d_inner the gate z
stage_definitions.scan.h_all: the state after every token  [B, L, d_inner, d_state]  (decode reference; L <= 4 cases only)
stage_definitions.scan.h_last: the state after the last token  [B, d_inner, d_state]
stage_definitions.scan.y: selective_scan_ref(u, dt, A=-exp(A_log), B, C, D, z=None, delta_bias, delta_softplus=True) = y_t + u_t*D, BEFORE the gate  [B, d_inner, L]
stage_definitions.softplus.out: softplus(dt_proj.out) with torch's threshold 20 (x if x > 20 else log1p(exp(x)))  [B, d_inner, L]  (this is delta)
stage_definitions.x_proj.out: silu.out.transpose(1,2) @ x_proj.weight^T  [B, L, dt_rank + 2*d_state]; columns split (dt_rank | B | C)
